statements.text: AI is being used, as we all know, to detect fraud and stop seniors from getting manipulated, those especially who are targeted by scams involving deepfakes and other AI-powered tools.
statements.context: House Financial Services Committee hearing on AI innovation in financial services.

statements.text: Regulators have used innovation hubs and sandboxes to encourage responsible experimentation in other areas of fintech. I am personally very focused on this area. [...] what features and guardrails do you think are essential for AI pilots to truly encourage innovation and protect consumers and communities in this space?
statements.context: Rep. Gottheimer questions a panel during a hearing on AI innovation in financial services.
